subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! What is the distance from the centre to the circle called?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Centre se circle tak ki doori ko kya kehte hain?
answer: The radius

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rectangle has one side 7 cm and the next side 4 cm. What are the other two sides?
prompt_hi: Ek rectangle ki ek side 7 cm aur agli side 4 cm hai. Baaki do sides kitni hain?
answer: 7 cm and 4 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: Push a square frame made of four equal sticks so it leans. Predict: is it still a square?
prompt_hi: Chaar barabar dandiyon se bane square frame ko dhakka do taaki woh jhuk jaaye. Guess karo: kya woh ab bhi square hai?
answer: No: the sides stay equal but the angles are no longer 90°, so it is a rhombus

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why do we need to check angles, not just sides, when constructing a square?
prompt_hi: Square banate waqt sirf sides nahi, angles bhi check karna kyon zaroori hai?
answer: Equal sides alone allow a squashed shape (a rhombus); a square also needs four right angles

subject: maths
prompt_en: Is every square a rectangle? Is every rectangle a square?
prompt_hi: Kya har square ek rectangle hai? Kya har rectangle ek square hai?
answer: Every square is a rectangle (four right angles, opposite sides equal); not every rectangle is a square

subject: maths
prompt_en: Neha says a square turned to stand on its corner becomes a diamond, not a square. Check her.
prompt_hi: Neha kehti hai kone pe khada kiya hua square diamond ban jaata hai, square nahi rehta. Check karo.
answer: It is still a square: turning changes neither the sides nor the angles

subject: maths
prompt_en: Say the steps to construct a rectangle 6 cm by 4 cm.
prompt_hi: 6 cm by 4 cm ka rectangle banane ke steps batao.
answer: Draw AB = 6 cm; make right angles at A and B; mark 4 cm up both lines with the compass to get D and C; join DC and check it is 6 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: You are constructing a square of side 5 cm. After drawing AB = 5 cm and right angles at A and B, how do you find C and D?
prompt_hi: Tum 5 cm side ka square bana rahe ho. AB = 5 cm aur A, B pe right angles banane ke baad C aur D kaise milenge?
answer: With the compass opened to 5 cm, mark 5 cm up each perpendicular from A and B, then join the two marks

subject: maths
prompt_en: A carpenter makes a window frame with sides 60, 40, 60 and 40 cm, but it wobbles out of shape. What should he check to be sure it is a rectangle?
prompt_hi: Ek carpenter 60, 40, 60 aur 40 cm sides wala khidki ka frame banata hai, par woh tedha ho jaata hai. Rectangle pakka karne ke liye use kya check karna chahiye?
answer: That the corners are right angles (for example by checking the two diagonals are equal)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Describe a rectangle using only its properties, without drawing it.
prompt_hi: Rectangle ko sirf uski properties se batao, banaye bina.
answer: A four-sided shape with four right angles whose opposite sides are equal

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend how to construct a square of side 4 cm.
prompt_hi: Dost ko 4 cm side ka square banana sikhao.
answer: Draw AB = 4 cm; make right angles at A and B; with the compass at 4 cm, mark D and C on those lines; join DC; check all sides are 4 cm and all angles 90°

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! What does a square have that not every rectangle has?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Square mein aisa kya hai jo har rectangle mein nahi hota?
answer: All four sides equal

subject: maths
prompt_en: The diagonals of a rectangle cross at O. If AC = 12 cm, how long is AO?
prompt_hi: Rectangle ke diagonals O pe katte hain. AC = 12 cm ho toh AO kitna hai?
answer: 6 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: Think of a long, thin rectangle like a cricket pitch. Predict: do its diagonals cross at a right angle?
prompt_hi: Cricket pitch jaisa lamba-patla rectangle socho. Guess karo: kya iske diagonals right angle pe katte hain?
answer: No: they cross at a narrow angle and a wide angle

subject: maths
prompt_en: Compare the diagonals of a square with those of a long rectangle. What is the same, and what is different?
prompt_hi: Square ke diagonals ko lambe rectangle ke diagonals se compare karo. Kya same hai, kya alag?
answer: Same: both pairs are equal and cut each other in half. Different: the square's cross at right angles, the rectangle's do not

subject: maths
prompt_en: Two houses are at A and B. With the compass open to 5 cm, you draw arcs from A and from B, and they cross at P. What is special about P?
prompt_hi: Do ghar A aur B pe hain. Compass 5 cm khol kar A se aur B se arcs banaye, jo P pe katte hain. P mein kya khaas hai?
answer: P is 5 cm from both A and B: it is equidistant

subject: maths
prompt_en: Predict: is the midpoint of AB the only point that is equally far from A and B?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: kya AB ka midpoint hi akela point hai jo A aur B se barabar door hai?
answer: No: there are infinitely many, all on the line through the midpoint at right angles to AB

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why must we use the same compass opening from both A and B?
prompt_hi: A aur B dono se same compass opening kyon use karni padti hai?
answer: Equidistant means the distances are equal; the compass opening is that distance, so it must be the same from both points

subject: maths
prompt_en: Rahul drew an arc of 4 cm from A and an arc of 6 cm from B and said the crossing point is equally far from A and B. Correct him.
prompt_hi: Rahul ne A se 4 cm aur B se 6 cm ka arc banaya aur kaha kaatne wala point A aur B se barabar door hai. Usse theek karo.
answer: No: that point is 4 cm from A and 6 cm from B; he must use the same opening from both

subject: maths
prompt_en: Two houses want a water tank that is equally far from both. Where can it go? And if it must also be on the road that runs beside both houses?
prompt_hi: Do ghar aisa paani ka tank chahte hain jo dono se barabar door ho. Woh kahan lag sakta hai? Aur agar use dono gharon ke paas wali sadak pe bhi hona ho?
answer: Anywhere on the line through the midpoint of the two houses at right angles to the line joining them; on the road, at the point where that line meets the road

subject: maths
prompt_en: A and B are 8 cm apart. Find a point that is 5 cm from both. How?
prompt_hi: A aur B 8 cm door hain. Aisa point dhoondo jo dono se 5 cm door ho. Kaise?
answer: Open the compass to 5 cm and draw arcs from A and from B; they cross at two points, one on each side of AB

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rectangle is 6 cm by 8 cm and its diagonal is 10 cm. Describe where the diagonals cross and how far that point is from each corner.
prompt_hi: Ek rectangle 6 cm by 8 cm ka hai aur diagonal 10 cm hai. Batao diagonals kahan katte hain aur woh point har kone se kitna door hai.
answer: At the centre of the rectangle, 5 cm from each corner

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend how to find all the places equally far from two trees, using a rope.
prompt_hi: Dost ko sikhao rassi se do pedon se barabar doori wali saari jagah kaise dhoondein.
answer: Hold one length of rope at each tree in turn and mark where the two equal arcs cross; repeat with other lengths; all the marks lie on a straight line through the middle, at right angles to the line joining the trees

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! Are a rectangle's diagonals equal?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Kya rectangle ke diagonals barabar hote hain?
answer: Yes

subject: maths
prompt_en: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle that is not a square have?
prompt_hi: Jo rectangle square nahi hai, uski kitni lines of symmetry hoti hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why isn't a rectangle's diagonal a line of symmetry, even though it cuts the rectangle into two equal triangles?
prompt_hi: Rectangle ka diagonal use do barabar triangles mein kaatta hai, phir bhi line of symmetry kyon nahi hai?
answer: Equal halves are not enough; folding along the diagonal does not make one half land on the other, because they are not mirror images across that line

subject: maths
prompt_en: Which of these letters have a horizontal line of symmetry: B, A, E, T?
prompt_hi: Inme se kin letters mein horizontal line of symmetry hai: B, A, E, T?
answer: B and E

subject: maths
prompt_en: Compare the letters H and N. Which has line symmetry?
prompt_hi: Letters H aur N compare karo. Kisme line symmetry hai?
answer: H has two lines (vertical and horizontal); N has none

subject: maths
prompt_en: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have? A regular hexagon?
prompt_hi: Equilateral triangle ki kitni lines of symmetry hain? Regular hexagon ki?
answer: 3 and 6

subject: maths
prompt_en: Kiran says a slanting parallelogram has a line of symmetry along its diagonal, because the two triangles are equal. Check.
prompt_hi: Kiran kehta hai tirchhe parallelogram ka diagonal line of symmetry hai, kyunki do triangles barabar hain. Check karo.
answer: No: folding along the diagonal does not match the halves; a slanting parallelogram has no lines of symmetry

subject: maths
prompt_en: The front view of the Taj Mahal has a line of symmetry. Where is it? If a minaret stands 20 m to the left of that line, what is on the right?
prompt_hi: Taj Mahal ke front view mein ek line of symmetry hai. Woh kahan hai? Agar ek minar line se 20 m left mein hai, toh right mein kya hoga?
answer: A vertical line through the middle of the main dome; a matching minaret 20 m to the right

subject: maths
prompt_en: On grid paper, a point is 3 squares to the left of a vertical mirror line. Where is its mirror point?
prompt_hi: Grid paper pe ek point vertical mirror line se 3 squares left mein hai. Uska mirror point kahan hoga?
answer: 3 squares to the right of the line, at the same height

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend how to test whether a line is a line of symmetry.
prompt_hi: Dost ko sikhao kaise test karein ki koi line, line of symmetry hai ya nahi.
answer: Fold along the line (or stand a mirror on it); if the two halves match exactly, point for point, it is a line of symmetry; equal size alone is not enough

subject: maths
prompt_en: How many times does a square look the same during one full turn?
prompt_hi: Ek full turn mein square kitni baar same dikhta hai?
answer: 4 (order 4)

subject: maths
prompt_en: What is the angle of rotational symmetry for a square?
prompt_hi: Square ka angle of rotational symmetry kya hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: The letter S has no line of symmetry. Predict: does it look the same after half a turn?
prompt_hi: Letter S mein koi line of symmetry nahi hai. Guess karo: kya aadha ghumane pe same dikhega?
answer: Yes: it has rotational symmetry of order 2 (180°)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why is the order of rotational symmetry of a ceiling fan with 3 equally spaced blades 3?
prompt_hi: 3 barabar doori wale blades ke ceiling fan ka order of rotational symmetry 3 kyon hai?
answer: Every 120° each blade moves into the next blade's place, so it looks the same 3 times in one full turn

subject: maths
prompt_en: Look at the letters H and N. For each letter, say which kinds of symmetry it has: line symmetry, rotational symmetry, or both.
prompt_hi: Letters H aur N dekho. Har letter ke liye batao usme kaunsi symmetry hai: line symmetry, rotational symmetry, ya dono.
answer: H has both (two lines and order 2); N has only rotational symmetry (order 2)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Riya says, 'The angle of rotational symmetry of an equilateral triangle is 3.' Fix it.
prompt_hi: Riya kehti hai, 'Equilateral triangle ka angle of rotational symmetry 3 hai.' Theek karo.
answer: 3 is the order; the angle is 120°

subject: maths
prompt_en: A figure looks the same every 60°. What is its order of rotational symmetry?
prompt_hi: Ek figure har 60° pe same dikhta hai. Iska order of rotational symmetry kya hai?
